high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from TIME magazine. The content of the article discusses an athlete's performance in the women's 200-meter sprint at the U.S. Olympic Track & Field Team Trials. The athlete, Thomas, ran the 200-meter race in a time of 21.61 seconds, which is noted as the third-fastest 200-meter sprint of all time. This achievement made her the second-fastest woman in the history of the race, with Florence Griffith-Joyner being the only woman to have run faster than her. The article is displayed on a mobile device
